**Temporal dynamics**  

Seasonality is changing across the world with advanced climate change. 

**Spatial dynamics**  

Spatially variable subsidization of habitat patches leads to resource heterogeneity. 

**Food web complexity**  

Fully resolved food webs are becoming more and more common.
